test.title: Notifications are on
test.body: This device will get notifications from Semestra.

import_ready.title: Import ready to review
import_ready.body: Check what was found before it is added.

import_failed.title: Import failed
import_failed.body: Open the import to see what went wrong.

export_failed.title: Backup failed
export_failed.body: Start a new backup from Settings → Data.

restore_done.title: Backup restored
restore_done.body: The data from the backup is in place.

restore_failed.title: Restore failed
restore_failed.body: Open Settings → Data to try again.

model_ready.title: Local model downloaded
model_ready.body: It is ready to use on this server.

model_failed.title: Model download failed
model_failed.body: Open Settings → Data to try again.

approval.title: Sem is waiting for you
approval.body: Approve or decline the proposed changes to continue.

sign_in.title: New sign-in
sign_in.body: $device signed in to your account. Not you? Sign it out in Settings → Account.
